floorPlans.label: Emaar Montura 3 original floor plans
floorPlans.introduction: Compare two four-bedroom and two five-bedroom Villa B layouts. Each original Montura 3 sheet shows the ground, first and second floors and its plot key.
floorPlans.note: The developer totals include the balcony and carport shown on the sheet. Confirm the signed plan, area and specifications for your plot.

review.images: Reviewed the own wide hero and six official gallery scenes. Omitted the smaller duplicate of the wide frontage. Shared lawn, living room and bedroom scenes match Montura 2. Used the separate Montura 3 dusk street scene on the listing card.
review.location: Checked the named developer point, cluster map on physical page 6 and the brochure estimates on physical page 5. Brochure and general community site estimate scopes differ. Community comparison: https://www.emaar.com/en/our-communities/grand-polo-club-and-resort
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all five pages and kept the four complete Montura 3 layouts. Numbers were read directly from the visual area panels. All four imperial totals reconcile within 0.01 sq ft. Checked each phase-specific key plan.

unavailable: Signed unit-specific areas and entrance-level routes were not verified.
